# How much indirect cost can you charge on this grant budget?

> Free grant budget calculator: find your modified total direct costs (MTDC) with the $50,000 subaward and $10,000 equipment rules applied, the indirect cost you can charge at 15% de minimis or your negotiated rate, and how much direct budget fits under a funder's total award cap.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [What is MTDC, and how to calculate indirect costs on a grant budget](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/grant-indirect-cost-calculator/what-is-modified-total-direct-costs.html)
